controls.title: Parking area illuminance
controls.objective: Parking areas meet the site's minimum illuminance target at night.

evidence.description: Light meter readings at the darkest points

questions.text: Lowest horizontal illuminance measured at grade in the parking area at night
questions.guidance: Take readings with a calibrated meter at the darkest visible points, sensor flat at grade. 1 foot-candle = 10.76 lux. Compare with the site target or ANSI/IES RP-20 (unverified).

questions.text: Ratio of the highest to the lowest horizontal reading across the parking area
questions.guidance: Divide the highest reading by the lowest. Higher ratios mean darker gaps; compare with the design target.

controls.title: Pedestrian path lighting continuity
controls.objective: Exterior pedestrian paths are lit at night with no unlit gaps between fixtures.

evidence.description: Night photo of each unlit gap

questions.text: Are exterior pedestrian paths lit at night with no unlit gaps between fixtures?
questions.guidance: Walk each path at night. A gap is a stretch where a person's face cannot be seen at 30 ft (9 m). Photograph each gap.

references.source: Crowe and Fennelly, Crime Prevention Through Environmental Design, 3rd ed., 2013

controls.title: Entrance lighting
controls.objective: Every building entrance is lit so that faces are visible to people and cameras.

evidence.description: Vertical illuminance reading at each entrance

questions.text: Lowest vertical illuminance measured at face height (5 ft, 1.5 m) at any building entrance at night
questions.guidance: Hold the meter vertical facing outward at the threshold. Record the lowest entrance value.

controls.title: Lighting maintenance
controls.objective: Failed or damaged exterior fixtures are found and repaired within a defined time.

questions.text: Number of exterior fixtures out, dim, or damaged at the time of the night inspection
Is there a defined repair time for failed exterior lights (for example 72 hours) and was it met for the last 5 work orders?
questions.guidance: Partial: target defined but not met.

controls.title: Lighting control and backup power
controls.objective: Exterior lights switch on automatically and critical lighting has backup power.

questions.text: Are exterior lights controlled by photocell or astronomical timer rather than manual switching?
Is lighting at entrances, camera views, and guard posts on emergency or generator power?
questions.guidance: Check panel schedules or ask facilities to show the circuits.

controls.title: Glare and camera coordination
controls.objective: Fixtures do not shine into camera lenses or guard sightlines.

questions.text: Is every camera view and guard sightline free of light fixtures shining directly toward it?
questions.guidance: Check night camera views for bright fixtures in frame. Photograph conflicts.
